newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines vows to help Laos get ASEAN membership.
newsitem.headline: Philippines vows to help Laos get ASEAN membership.

text.p: The Philippines has promised to help Laos become a member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), the presidential palace said on Thursday.

"We will be ready to help you in any way whether in government affairs and especially your membership in ASEAN," President Fidel Ramos was quoted as telling Samane Vignaket, chairman of the Lao National Assembly, during a meeting.
Vignaket is leading a high-level parliamentary delegation on a four-day visit to Manila.
Laos currently has observer status in ASEAN which groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
